title: Devi Bar
description: AI avatar Hinglish Reels for nutrition & lifestyle coaching with personalized lead magnet guides via AutoDM.
full_content: Devi is an Indian lifestyle & nutrition coach who helps women transform through nutrition, mindset shifts, and lifestyle habits. Her content focuses on practical nutrition hacks, emotional eating patterns, relationship dynamics, and personal growth. All content is delivered via AI avatar in Hinglish to connect authentically with her audience.
full_description: Devi's Instagram presence grew from 0 to 50K+ followers through consistent AI avatar Reels and AutoDM lead magnets. Each reel follows the "Hold 4 Twist 1" method (freezing Format, Idea, Hook, Script, and Visuals while changing only 1 element per iteration). Her content strategy centers on conversational hooks under 7 seconds, curiosity-driven openers, and warm, motherly brand voice. The AutoDM system delivers high-value guides via DMs when users engage with CTAs, converting followers to paying coaching clients. Production pipeline: competitor analysis → hook writing (10/10 scoring) → Hinglish script (40–90 sec) → caption (under 50 words, SEO keywords embedded) → HeyGen AI avatar → ElevenLabs voice clone → Premiere Pro edit → Meta scheduling.
results: 0 to 50K+ followers. AutoDM lead magnet conversion pipeline live.

title: Krish Computer
description: Social media captions and product marketing for a family-run computer retail and custom PC build business in Vadodara.
full_content: Krish Computer is a Vadodara-based retail store specializing in computer sales, repairs, and custom PC builds. Founded in 2008, the business serves both retail customers and corporate clients. Content strategy focuses on product launches, specs comparisons, build showcases, repair tips, and local community engagement.
full_description: Krish Computer's Instagram presence showcases high-performance builds, repair case studies, and product launches to both tech enthusiasts and budget-conscious buyers in Vadodara. Each product caption follows a strict format: specs listed line-by-line, one compelling main sentence about value, a clear CTA, keywords embedded in body text, and hashtags starting with #KrishComputer and #Vadodara. The content strategy drives foot traffic to the physical store and online inquiries for custom builds and repair services. Posts highlight trending tech, seasonal offers, customer testimonials, and build transformations. Photography focuses on product detail shots and in-store setup scenes.
results: Noticeable sales improvement. Cleaner product page conversion driving foot traffic.

title: Freelance Video Production

full_description: Freelance video projects showcase versatility across multiple industries and content formats. title: AI Films
description: Experimental short films created entirely using AI video generation, voice cloning, and automated editing to showcase the creative potential of emerging AI tools.
full_content: AI Films is a personal creative project exploring the intersection of artificial intelligence and filmmaking. Projects include fully AI-generated narrative films, AI-assisted documentary editing, voice-cloned narration projects, and experimental music videos. Each film demonstrates a specific AI capability—text-to-video generation, avatar-based storytelling, voice synthesis, or automated color grading. The project serves as both creative expression and a case study in how AI tools can expand filmmaking possibilities for independent creators.
full_description: AI Films represents an experimental exploration of emerging AI technologies in creative filmmaking. Projects include: (1) Narrative films using text-to-video models (Kling AI, Runway Gen-3) to generate cinematography, with human-written scripts and AI voice synthesis via ElevenLabs; (2) Documentary-style pieces with AI avatar narration and automated editing; (3) Music videos blending AI-generated visuals with sound design; (4) Proof-of-concept short films testing new AI capabilities (e.g., real-time voice cloning, dynamic scene generation). Each project is documented with behind-the-scenes breakdowns showing prompt engineering, tool workflows, and post-production refinements. Average project scope: 3–15 minute format. The goal is to democratize filmmaking by proving that compelling visual stories can be created without traditional filming infrastructure, empowering indie creators and small studios to compete with larger production companies.
results: Multiple AI short films produced. Attracted enterprise clients from demo reel.
